blocks.text: Mistral Large 2 is a proprietary language model from Mistral, released on Jul 24, 2024.
At $2 input and $6 output per million tokens, it ranks #25 of 40 for input price, placing it mid-range on input cost.
Its context window of 128K tokens ranks #40 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
Throughput is measured at 55 tokens per second (ranked #21 of 23 for throughput).
123B params; 80+ coding languages; Mistral Research License (weights downloadable, not fully commercial).
No independently verified benchmark scores are available for this model. Scores are only shown when independently confirmed with a source URL.
